title: Validate OptiSweep is back up after backup migration / planned restart (database, heartbeats, RMS visibility)
summary: After a primary failure with migration to a backup or during a planned restart, validate OptiSweep recovery by confirming the database is up, verifying heartbeats are present, restarting OptiSweep if heartbeats are missing, and confirming RMS is visible.
when_to_use: Use after migrating to a backup (primary failed) or during planned restarts to confirm the system is back and operational by checking database availability, heartbeat presence, and RMS visibility.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the post-restart validation sequence (database up check, heartbeat check, restart OptiSweep if heartbeats are missing, then confirm RMS visibility).
safety_notes: If RMS was shut down, it may come up with an E-stop; release the E-stop or have site release the E-stop.
access_or_tools_needed: OptiSweep restart capability (as described in the source)
Access to the interface that shows database-up status
Access to the interface that shows heartbeats
Access to the interface that shows RMS visibility

access_required: Access to the OptiSweep restart capability
Access to the database status view
Access to the heartbeat indicator/status view
system_preconditions: A backup migration or planned restart has occurred (primary failed or planned restart scenario).

steps.title: Confirm the database is up after backup migration / planned restart
steps.purpose: Establish that the recovered system has database availability before validating operational health indicators.
steps.instruction: On the live system, check the interface that indicates database availability and confirm the database is up following the backup migration or planned restart.
steps.expected_result: Database is up (database availability indicator shows up/healthy).
steps.healthy_condition: Database-up status is present/indicates the database is running and reachable.
steps.failure_condition: Database is not up (database-up status is missing or indicates failure/unavailable).

actions.label: Check database-up status
actions.exact_action: Check, make sure the database is up.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the database is not up, escalate for deeper troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: For backup migration or planned restarts... check, make sure the database is up...
Frame transcript includes the described sequence: check database up, check heartbeats, restart OptiSweep if heartbeats aren’t there, then check RMS visibility.

steps.title: Check for heartbeats (tippers heartbeats)
steps.purpose: Use heartbeats as an operational health indicator after restart/migration.
steps.instruction: On the live system, check the heartbeat indicator/status for tippers and confirm heartbeats are present (not flat lined).
steps.healthy_condition: Heartbeat indicator shows active/received heartbeats for tippers.
steps.failure_condition: Heartbeats are flat lined / not being received for tippers.

actions.label: Check tippers heartbeats
actions.exact_action: Check to make sure that tippers are getting heartbeats.

stop_or_escalate_if: If heartbeats are flat lined (missing), proceed to restart OptiSweep in the next step.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: check the heartbeats. If the heartbeats aren't there... restart Opti sweep...
Check to make sure that tippers are getting heartbeats. If the heartbeats are flat lines... If you're not getting heartbeats, you have to restart Opti Sweep...

steps.title: Restart OptiSweep if heartbeats are missing / flat lined
steps.purpose: Restore the service when heartbeats are not being received after restart/migration.
steps.instruction: If heartbeats are flat lined/missing, restart OptiSweep using the restart capability available to you, then re-check heartbeats as needed before proceeding to RMS visibility.
steps.expected_result: After restart, heartbeats are no longer flat lined (heartbeats become present).
steps.healthy_condition: Heartbeat indicator returns to active/received state after OptiSweep restart.
steps.failure_condition: Heartbeats remain missing/flat lined after restarting OptiSweep.
stop_or_escalate_if: If heartbeats remain missing after restarting OptiSweep, escalate for deeper troubleshooting.

steps.title: Confirm RMS is visible after restart / if heartbeats were already present
steps.purpose: Verify end-to-end operational visibility in RMS after recovery actions.
steps.instruction: After restart (or if heartbeats were already present), check RMS visibility in the RMS interface and confirm RMS can be seen.
steps.expected_result: RMS is visible (RMS visibility/status indicates it is present).
steps.healthy_condition: RMS interface shows the expected RMS view/visibility after recovery.
steps.failure_condition: RMS cannot be seen after the checks.

actions.label: Check RMS visibility
actions.exact_action: check to make sure you can see RMS.

stop_or_escalate_if: If RMS cannot be seen after the checks, escalate for further investigation.
